title: AF01 gravel frameset
notes: Current exact-model page lists T800 + M46 carbon, manufacturer-described one-piece molding, embedded aluminum fork inserts, an integrated anti-drop seat clamp, sealed downtube storage and a comfort-tuned seatpost. It also lists a selected US$1,099 frameset/handlebar option, 1,200 g finished size-M frame including hardware and paint (±50 g), 520 g finished fork (±15 g), T47-86, UDH, 50C clearance and a five-year warranty. Raw frame/fork claims are 980 g and 485 g excluding hardware and paint. No ply schedule, measured stiffness result or mainland CNY checkout was captured; molding-factory ownership remains unclear.
